title: Woody Woodpecker in Crazy Castle 5
sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

widgets.text:
Health; lives
Puzzle-platformer in the Crazy Castle series: collect every key on a floor to open its exit door
Lives; enemies chase Woody around the floor

Platform puzzle moves
Woody can use items found on each floor to stun enemies (push, throw or drop them)
Pipes and stairs connect the platforms: plan a route that collects keys without getting cornered

Castle bosses
Enemies follow patterns: wait for them to pass, then grab the key behind them
Some floors end with a boss room

Castle floors
Floors of the castle, played in order; passwords or saves keep your floor
Solo and multi-player modes (link cable) appear in the menu

Keys
Keys per floor; items to push or throw
Collect every key on a floor to open its exit door

Hidden items
Bonus items on floors for extra points
Bonus items give points; some floors have hidden extra lives

Floors cleared
Floors cleared to the top of the castle (developed by Tantalus of Australia)
